title: TS-08 Organizations, membership and identity kernel
description:
## Slice 2 ticket 8 of 40, phase notes: paths use `conversation/` (the workspace as it is on develop). Design source: `git show origin/docs/typescript-control-plane:docs/TYPESCRIPT_CONTROL_PLANE.md` (section 8, row 8); read sections 0.3, 2, 3 and 6 as needed. Read AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md first. Never read or write `project/`; use `kbs` only.

## Goal
Port the organization record, membership, identity and role logic as TypeScript domain modules on top of the item codecs.

## Kind
mechanical-port: the Python source below is the specification. Keep its structure, names (camelCase), branches and messages. Do not redesign anything.

## Branch and commit
```text
git fetch origin
git switch -c ts/08-organizations-membership-and-identity-ke origin/develop
...work, then...
git add <only the files listed under Files>
git commit -m "feat(conversation): organizations, membership and identity kernel

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
git push -u origin ts/08-organizations-membership-and-identity-ke
```
Do NOT open a pull request; the orchestrator opens it. Commit messages contain no emojis.

## Files to create or change
- `conversation/src/domain/organizations.ts`
- `conversation/src/domain/membership.ts`
- `conversation/src/domain/identity.ts`
- `conversation/src/domain/roles.ts`
- `conversation/features-support/steps/org.steps.ts`
- `conversation/features-support/steps/membership.steps.ts`

## Exported interface and error behavior
Functions are the camelCase of the Python functions with identical semantics; each takes `(deps: {store: MessagingStore; clock: Clock; ids: IdSource}, ...args)`. `MessagingStore` is a thin class over DynamoDBClient in conversation/src/store/messaging-store.ts (create it here: `get(key)`, `put(item, condition?)`, `update(...)`, `query(...)`, `transactWrite(...)`; ConditionalCheckFailed surfaces as `ConditionFailed`). Roles are the same string literals as roles.py.

General rules: TypeScript ESM, `.ts` import suffixes as in conversation/src/storage/; tabs for indentation as in existing files; long clear names; no line comments; TSDoc on exported symbols; no emojis. Each Python exception class used by a ported function becomes an exported `Error` subclass with the same name and the same message text. Failures are thrown, never returned as magic values, unless the Python returned them.

## Python source to port (keep structure; read it fully before writing)
- `python/src/chatticus/org_records.py (604 lines; split in two commits at the line where the invitation functions begin)`
- `python/src/chatticus/roles.py (42 lines)`
- `python/src/chatticus/principal.py (identity-by-email functions only)`
Rule: mechanical ports keep the Python file's structure and cite the Python line range in the commit body. Behavior that no scenario encodes is still kept.

## Behavior spec (Gherkin, ported unchanged)
Existing features that must pass under cucumber-js when this ticket closes. Do NOT edit these `.feature` files except where this ticket says a behavior changed.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Corrections from the TS-07 prototype (branch ts/07-cognito-verifier, 232def30). Apply to this ticket: (1) the conversation tsconfig has erasableSyntaxOnly, so constructor parameter properties are not allowed; declare fields explicitly. (2) A missing Authorization header is 403 in Python and in the features, not 401. (3) Check org status ENABLED after resolving the principal, as verify_org_access does, because the suspended scenario needs the suspended principal back. (4) The Principal type includes organizationStatus and workerId. (5) test-jwt.ts both mints tokens and holds the injected JWKS. (6) cucumber-js with a single .feature path still runs the whole manifest. (7) aws-jwt-verify 5.2.1 and jose 6.2.12 are pinned exactly: CognitoJwtVerifier.create({userPoolId, tokenUse:'id', clientId}), verifier.cacheJwks(jwks) is synchronous, verifier.verify(token) is async, and an unknown kid triggers a network JWKS refetch, so tests reuse the kid.

right_now_summary: The TypeScript organization and identity kernel is being ported with TS-07 corrections applied.
